settings.heroEyebrow: Home-raised Yorkies, Yorkipoos and Morkies in Gilbert, Arizona
settings.heroHeadline: Raised in our home, one small litter at a time.
settings.introBody: I raise a few litters a year in my own home. Every puppy is held, handled and known by name long before going home, and every family is someone I have talked to myself.
settings.heroSubhead: The puppies are a part of my family before they become a part of yours.
settings.ownerStory:
I am the owner and caretaker of every puppy here, and their first human contact from the day they are born. The moms are my babies, and I choose each dad for a great temperament and good health.

Our puppies grow up in play pens in our family home, not cages, with plenty of socialization and cuddles. Each puppy and parent is seen by a veterinarian I trust. I screen every new family and love keeping in touch as your puppy grows.

I love what I do.

breeds.name: Yorkie
breeds.grooming: Daily brushing or a short puppy cut. Regular trims.
breeds.temperament: Bold, affectionate and alert. Bonds closely with its people.
breeds.goodFor: Apartments and homes with older, gentle children.
breeds.summary: A small terrier with a big personality and a fine, silky coat.

breeds.name: Yorkipoo
breeds.grooming: Brushing a few times a week and a trim every six to eight weeks.
breeds.goodFor: First-time owners and active small households.
breeds.summary: A Yorkshire Terrier and Toy Poodle cross, usually with a soft, wavy, low-shedding coat.
breeds.exercise: Daily walks and games. Enjoys learning tricks.

breeds.name: Morkie
breeds.grooming: Brushing most days and regular trims.
breeds.temperament: Affectionate, lively and happiest close to you.
breeds.goodFor: Companionship-focused homes where someone is often around.
breeds.summary: A Maltese and Yorkshire Terrier cross with a soft coat and a gentle, sociable nature.

weeks.body: Every litter is born in our home, and I am the first person each puppy meets. Mom and babies rest in a soft play pen, never a cage, where I can watch them day and night.

weeks.body: Puppies start to explore, wobble and play. They hear the sounds of a real household: voices, the vacuum, the doorbell, children laughing.

weeks.body: We begin puppy-pad training, gentle handling of paws and ears, and lots of cuddles from the family. Each puppy is seen by our trusted veterinarian.

faq.question: How much is a puppy?
faq.answer: Every puppy is different, so I don't post prices. Ask for a free quote and I'll get back to you with one. There's no obligation.

faq.question: Does asking for a quote reserve a puppy?
faq.answer: No. A quote is free and starts a conversation. A puppy is reserved only once we have talked and you have agreed to the deposit terms in writing.

faq.question: How do I reserve a puppy?
faq.answer: Start by asking for a free quote. I'll reach out by phone or text to talk about your home and the puppy you're hoping for. If we're a good match, you can reserve with a deposit. The deposit terms are explained in writing before you pay anything.

faq.question: Who will I be talking to?
faq.answer: Me. I read every request myself, and I'm the one who calls or texts you back.

faq.question: How much is the deposit, and is it refundable?
What comes home with my puppy?
faq.answer: Your puppy's medical records, a record of vaccinations to date, and the routine they are used to.

faq.question: Are the puppies seen by a vet?
faq.answer: Yes. Every puppy and parent is seen by a veterinarian we trust.

faq.question: Where are you located?
faq.answer: We are a home breeder in Gilbert, Arizona. The exact address is shared once a visit or pickup is arranged.

faq.question: Can I visit before I decide?
What's the difference between a Yorkie, a Yorkipoo and a Morkie?
faq.answer: A Yorkie is a purebred Yorkshire Terrier. A Yorkipoo is a Yorkie crossed with a Toy or Miniature Poodle, and a Morkie is a Yorkie crossed with a Maltese.
